of quality or degree, great, mighty, freq. epith. of gods, ὁ μ. Ζεύς (lyr.), etc.; μεγάλα θεά, of Demeter and Persephone, (lyr.); θεοὶ μεγάλοι, of the Cabiri, (Imbros), etc.; Μήτηρ μ., of Cybele, (Erythrae, iii B. C.), (Delos, ii B. C.); Μήτηρ θεῶν μ.
